description: Asks AI assistants a local buyer question, "best <query> in <city>", and reads whether each answer names the business. Use it to measure local AI visibility against competitors. source assist (the default, free) asks in the user's own signed-in browser sessions, and an engine the user is not signed in to comes back missing. source cloro asks ChatGPT, Gemini and AI Mode unattended through the user's Cloro key: about $0.014 for chatgpt and $0.012 each for gemini and ai_mode; call it first with estimateOnly true to get the price for the user to approve. A cloro run over the monthly cap, or with no key or cap set, is refused with an error saying so. Perplexity is always asked in assist mode. It works in the user's own Chrome through the Local SEO extension, opening Google Maps in a background tab, and fails with a message saying how to connect when the extension is not connected. Nothing is written to Google. Returns prompt, source, estimatedCostUsd (null for assist) and answers (empty with estimateOnly), one per engine: engine, and answer, either {missing: true, reason} or verdict (recommended when among the first three businesses named, named when later, absent), position (1-based among businesses named, null when absent), excerpt (the passage naming it, or the opening when absent), businessesNamed, competitorsNamed and citedUrls. One run is one sample; answers change between runs.

businessName.description: The business to look for in each answer, as people say its name.

city.description: The town or city, such as "West Nyack, NY".

competitors.description: Up to 10 competitor names to look for as well. Defaults to none.

engines.description: The assistants to ask: chatgpt, gemini, perplexity, ai_mode (Google AI Mode). Defaults to all four.

estimateOnly.description: Return only estimatedCostUsd and ask nothing, so the user can approve a cloro run first. Defaults to false.

query.description: What the customer wants, such as "emergency plumber" or "vegan bakery".

source.description: assist (the default) opens each assistant in the user's own signed-in browser tabs for free; the user may need to press Enter. cloro asks chatgpt, gemini and ai_mode unattended through the user's Cloro key, paid within the monthly cap set in the extension; perplexity is always asked in assist mode.

name: local_ai_visibility
title: Local AI visibility
